subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Postuer"** is incorrectly spelled. The correct spelling is **"Posture"**, which refers to the position or alignment of someone's body while standing or sitting. (अवस्था या मुद्रा)

 
 
• **Example:** Maintaining a good posture is essential for a healthy spine.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Gesture** (इशारा): Movement of the body or limbs to express an idea or emotion.

 
 
• **Example:** A thumbs-up is a common gesture for approval.
 
 
 
• **Culture** (संस्कृति): Collective customs, traditions, and values of a society.
 
 
• **Example:** The culture of a community shapes its identity.
 
 
 
• **Lecture** (व्याख्यान): Educational talk or presentation.
 
 
• **Example:** Students were attentive during the lecture on history.

The correct answer is: **Option 3**.
